name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.wordNodes_getElem
typeText:
∀ {d : Nat} (s : Nat),
  LE.le.{0} 1 s →
    ∀ (w : List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Letter.{0} (Fin d))) (p : Nat)
      (hp : LT.lt.{0} p (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.wordNodes s w).1)),
      ∃ l a,
        And
          (Eq.{1} (GetElem.getElem.{0, 0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.wordNodes s w).1 p hp)
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Node.app (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.letterCode l)
              (List.cons.{0} a List.nil.{0})))
          (LT.lt.{0} a (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} s p))

source.code:
theorem wordNodes_getElem (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (w : List (Letter (Fin d))) :
    ∀ p (hp : p < (wordNodes s w).1.length),
      ∃ (l : Letter (Fin d)) (a : ℕ), (wordNodes s w).1[p] = .app (letterCode l) [a] ∧ a < s + p := by
  induction w with
  | nil => intro p hp; simp [wordNodes] at hp
  | cons l w ih =>
      intro p hp
      simp only [wordNodes, List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hp
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p (wordNodes s w).1.length with h | h
      · obtain ⟨l', a, he, ha⟩ := ih p h
        refine ⟨l', a, ?_, ha⟩
        simp only [wordNodes]
        rw [List.getElem_append_left h]
        exact he
      · have hp' : p = (wordNodes s w).1.length := by omega
        subst hp'
        refine ⟨l, (wordNodes s w).2, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [wordNodes]
        · have := wordNodes_root_lt s hs w
          rw [wordNodes_length]
          exact this
